ceiling_directive: Prove matching honest-radius upper and all-procedure lower bounds for a nontrivial multi-cohort staircase family under the stated common-anchor, chart-gap, and bounded-incidence conditions.
improvement_directive: Extend the WSVD honesty and expected-radius analysis to a genuine multi-chart staggered wedge under the stated synchronization conditions, and construct a same-class packing attaining the same order. This would establish that the frontier is not peculiar to the balanced rank-one missing-quadrant experiment.
critique: The matched result is confined to a balanced square panel, rank one, one missing quadrant, and fixed interior incoherence; the general staggered multi-chart frontier and shrinking-incoherence regime remain open, so the note does not deliver a frontier for staggered low-rank panels broadly. The mu=1 characterization relies on saturated incoherence reducing the parameter space to equal-magnitude sign vectors and therefore remains another highly rigid endpoint experiment. The ATT proposition transfers coverage by norm duality but supplies neither an optimal-length result nor evidence that the resulting interval is practically competitive. The constructive upper argument also compresses the uniform synchronization, Jacobian, tail-integration, and nonlinear Taylor controls into asserted bounds rather than reproducible derivations, further limiting journal readiness. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
